The change would reach three REST-module call sites directly, and one more indirectly through the generic CRUD path. `LocationResource1_9` inherits `LocationResource1_8.save`, so it is also covered.

**Confirmed direct callers (in `openmrs-module-webservices.rest`)**

1. **`LocationResource1_8.save`**: the `DelegatingCrudResource` save override that handles location create and update. It returns `Context.getLocationService().saveLocation(location)` directly, so any change in return value or validation shows up in every location POST/PUT through the REST API. `openmrs-module-webservices.rest/omod/src/main/java/org/openmrs/module/webservices/rest/web/v1_0/resource/openmrs1_8/LocationResource1_8.java:221-224`
2. **`LocationAttributeResource1_9.save`**: adds a `LocationAttribute` to its parent location, then calls `saveLocation` on the parent and returns the attribute. A change to cascade behaviour or to what `saveLocation` does with attributes affects attribute creation. `openmrs-module-webservices.rest/omod/src/main/java/org/openmrs/module/webservices/rest/web/v1_0/resource/openmrs1_9/LocationAttributeResource1_9.java:88-103`
3. **`LocationAttributeResource1_9.delete`**: soft-deletes an attribute by setting voided and void reason, then calls `saveLocation` on the parent. Any change to how `saveLocation` treats voided children would affect attribute deletion. `openmrs-module-webservices.rest/omod/src/main/java/org/openmrs/module/webservices/rest/web/v1_0/resource/openmrs1_9/LocationAttributeResource1_9.java:109-114`

**Subclass that inherits the affected path**

4. **`LocationResource1_9`** extends `LocationResource1_8` and does not override `save`, so it inherits the behaviour in item 1. `openmrs-module-webservices.rest/omod/src/main/java/org/openmrs/module/webservices/rest/web/v1_0/resource/openmrs1_9/LocationResource1_9.java:32`

**Tests that call `saveLocation` directly (would fail or need updates if its behaviour changed)**

5. **`LocationController1_9Test`**, in `shouldOverwriteAListOfChildLocations` (line 164), `shouldIncludeTheParentLocation` (line 225) and `shouldIncludeTheListOfChildLocations` (line 242). `openmrs-module-webservices.rest/omod/src/test/java/org/openmrs/module/webservices/rest/web/v1_0/controller/openmrs1_9/LocationController1_9Test.java:159-174, 220-249`
6. **`LocationController1_9Test.shouldUnretireALocation`** (lines 193-206) does not call `saveLocation` itself, but it drives the REST save path in item 1 and would catch a behaviour change there. `openmrs-module-webservices.rest/omod/src/test/java/org/openmrs/module/webservices/rest/web/v1_0/controller/openmrs1_9/LocationController1_9Test.java:193-206`

**Likely but unverified**

- The generic `DelegatingCrudResource` create, update and delete paths in the REST framework call `save(...)` and `delete(...)` on resources through dynamic dispatch. I did not read that framework code, so they are not confirmed here. This is the path that makes item 1 reachable from every location endpoint.

**Ruled out**

- `LocationTagResource1_8` calls `saveLocationTag`, a different method, so it is not affected.
- `LocationAttributeTypeResource1_9` calls `saveLocationAttributeType`, also a different method.

**Core declarations (the changed behaviour)**

- The interface contract, with its `@PreAuthorize` check, is in `openmrs-core/api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/api/LocationService.java:55-68`.
- The implementation, which throws on a null name and resolves transient tags by name, starts at `openmrs-core/api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/api/impl/LocationServiceImpl.java:63-67`. I read only the first part of the body.
- `LocationDAO.saveLocation` and `HibernateLocationDAO.saveLocation` are the layer below the service. I did not read them, so they are not cited.

**Not checked**

- I did not read `DelegatingCrudResource` or any other REST framework class.
- I did not search the TypeScript repositories for consumers of the REST location endpoints.
- I did not read `LocationServiceImpl.saveLocation` past line 84.
